verses.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤਿ ਅਖਾਜੁ ਗੁਮਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਹੁ ਸਤਾਣਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਖਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: hasat akhaaj gumaan kar seeh sataanaa koi na khaiee|

en.bdb: The proud elephant is inedible and none eats the mighty lion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਬਕਰੀ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: hoi nimaanee bakaree dheen dhunee vaddiaaiee paiee|

en.bdb: Goat is humble and hence it is respected everywhere.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਰਣੈ ਪਰਣੈ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਜਗਿ ਭੋਗਿ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: maranai paranai ma(n)neeaai jag bhog paravaan karaiee|

en.bdb: On occasions of death, joy, marriage, yajna, etc only its meat dis accepted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਸੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਸਤ ਨੋ ਆਂਦਹੁ ਤਾਰ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਵਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: maas pavitr girahasat no aa(n)dhahu taar veechaar vajaiee|

en.bdb: Among the householders its meat is acknowledged as sacred and with its gut stringed instruments are made.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਮੜੇ ਦੀਆ ਕਰਿ ਜੁਤੀਆ ਸਾਧੂ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣਿ ਲਿਵਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: chamaRe dheeaa kar juteeaa saadhoo charan saran livalaiee|

en.bdb: From its leather the shoes are made to be used by the saints merged in their meditation upon the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੂਰ ਪਖਾਵਜ ਮੜੀਦੇ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: toor pakhaavaj maReedhe keeratan saadhasa(n)gat sukhadhaiee|

en.bdb: Drums are mounted by its skin and then in the holy congregation the delight-giving kirtan, eulogy of the Lord, is sung.
In fact, going to the holy congregation is the same as going to the shelter of the true Guru.
